instruction: I'm working on a presentation and don't want the screen to lock while I'm reading slides. Please disable the automatic screen lock for me.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling automatic screen lock via gsettings. The setup enables lock-enabled, and the task asks the user to disable it. Evaluator verifies the setting is changed to false using exact_match metric with vm_command_line getter.
metadata.verification: Verified by checking gsettings screensaver lock-enabled pattern - the setting is a boolean that should be toggled from true to false.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to disable automatic screen lock
Getter uses appropriate vm_command_line with correct gsettings command to retrieve lock-enabled state
Expected value 'false\n' correctly represents the disabled state (includes newline from command output)
Metric exact_match is appropriate for boolean setting verification
Complete coverage: single requirement (disable screen lock) is fully verified
Data flow is correct: getter extracts setting -> metric compares exact string -> expected value matches disabled state
State is persistent and accessible without requiring postconfig
